name: AI Video Maker FX
original_description:
Create polished videos from simple text prompts. Turn natural-language direction into videos for social content, product stories, cinematic concepts, business promotions, and more.

- Describe your idea naturally; the Infoseek agent helps shape it into a strong video prompt
- Generate text-to-video clips, animate image references, edit videos, or extend existing clips
- Reference up to 10 image references or one MP4 video reference
- Set your aspect ratio, quality, duration, and audio settings
- Easily share or download completed videos
- Supports many languages and accents; pronunciation, timing, and speaker attribution may vary
- Use your Infoseek account to access your saved videos, music, and more
summary_ja: 文章や画像をもとに動画を生成し、既存動画の編集・延長を支援する。
limitations_ja: 画像参照は最大10点、動画参照はMP4形式1点。発音・タイミング・話者の割り当ては変わる場合がある。
